gloss: to shorten; to reduce; to cut down

definitions.gloss: to shorten; to reduce; to cut down
definitions.explanation: To make something shorter in time or length. Most commonly used for reducing time (working hours, deadlines, distances) rather than physical objects.

examples.japanese: {労働|ろうどう}{時間|じかん}を{短縮|たんしゅく}する。
{新|しん}ルートで{通勤|つうきん}{時間|じかん}が{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}{短縮|たんしゅく}された。
examples.english: The new route shortened my commute by thirty minutes.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}{時間|じかん}を{短縮|たんしゅく}して{営業|えいぎょう}いたします。
examples.english: We will operate with shortened business hours.

examples.japanese: この{技術|ぎじゅつ}により、{製造|せいぞう}{工程|こうてい}を{大幅|おおはば}に{短縮|たんしゅく}することが{可能|かのう}になった。
examples.english: This technology made it possible to significantly shorten the manufacturing process.

notes:
Primarily used for reducing time or duration rather than physical length. Very common in business and news contexts, especially regarding work reform ({働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時間|じかん}{短縮|たんしゅく}: time reduction
- {工期|こうき}{短縮|たんしゅく}: shortened construction period
- {短縮|たんしゅく}{営業|えいぎょう}: reduced business hours
- URL{短縮|たんしゅく}: URL shortening
- {距離|きょり}の{短縮|たんしゅく}: distance reduction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {縮|ちぢ}める: to shrink — more physical; making something smaller
- {省略|しょうりゃく}する: to abbreviate — omitting parts of text or speech
- {削減|さくげん}する: to cut — reducing quantity or budget
